services.name: Netflix
services.pricing_source: Netflix Help Center: Plans and Pricing

plans.name: Premium
plans.note: 4 streams, 4K and HDR where available, no ads

services.extras: Extra member slots: $7.99/month with ads or $9.99/month without ads (1 on Standard, up to 2 on Premium).
services.live_sports: Selected live events. Netflix has streamed NFL Christmas Day games and carries WWE Raw weekly.
services.kids: Kids profiles with maturity-rating controls and a large library of animated originals.
best_for: A deep library of originals in every genre
Households that want one service and do not need live TV
not_for: Live local channels or regular-season sports
services.answer: Netflix is the safest single pick if you want a large original library and no live TV. The ad plan costs $8.99 a month; ad-free starts at $19.99, and 4K needs the $26.99 Premium plan.
detail: Netflix has three US plans. The ad-supported plan is the cheapest way in, and it streams in up to 1080p on two screens at once. Standard removes ads at the same quality. Premium is the only plan with 4K, HDR and four simultaneous streams.
Netflix does not offer live channels, so it pairs well with a live TV service or an antenna. Its live programming is limited to specific events and WWE Raw.
If you share an account with someone outside your household, Netflix charges for an extra member slot instead of allowing free password sharing.

services.name: Hulu
services.pricing_source: Hulu Help Center: Hulu plans and prices

plans.name: Hulu + Live TV, Disney+, ESPN Select
Live TV Only
plans.note: Live channels without the on-demand bundle

services.extras: Disney also sells a Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max bundle at $21.99/month with ads or $34.99/month without ads.
services.live_sports: Only through Hulu + Live TV, which includes ESPN channels and local networks where available.
services.kids: Kids profiles; most family content sits in Disney+, which is why the bundle is popular.
services.locals: Next-day episodes of many network shows on demand. Live locals only with Hulu + Live TV.
services.trial: Varies by offer; check the sign-up page.
best_for: Next-day TV episodes and FX series
People who also want Disney+ (the bundle costs 50 cents more than Hulu alone)
not_for: Anyone who only wants one standalone ad-free service at a low price
services.answer: Hulu is best bought as part of the Disney+, Hulu bundle: $12.99 a month with ads, only 50 cents more than Hulu alone at $12.49. Ad-free Hulu by itself costs $21.49.
detail: Hulu's own plans are $12.49 with ads and $21.49 without. Disney prices its bundles so that adding Disney+ costs very little, so most people should compare the bundle, not Hulu alone.
Hulu + Live TV is Disney's live TV package. It bundles live channels with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Select for $99.99 a month, and a live-only option lists at $98.99.
Hulu is strong on current TV: many network and FX series arrive the day after they air.

services.name: Disney+
services.pricing_source: Disney+ Help Center: Disney+ plans and prices
services.extras: Bundles with HBO Max ($21.99 with ads, $34.99 without) and ESPN Unlimited ($35.99 with ads) are listed on Hulu's pricing page.
services.four_k: 4K and HDR on the Premium plan
services.live_sports: Some ESPN content appears inside Disney+ for bundle subscribers.
services.kids: The strongest family catalog: Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars and National Geographic.
best_for: Families with young kids
Marvel, Star Wars and Pixar fans
not_for: Adults who mainly want prestige drama or live TV
services.answer: Disney+ is the top family pick, but it is rarely worth buying alone: the Disney+, Hulu bundle with ads costs $12.99 a month, just 50 cents more than Disney+ by itself at $12.49.
detail: Disney+ raised prices in September 2026. The ad plan is $12.49 a month and Premium, which removes ads, is $21.49 or $214.99 a year.
The catalog centers on Disney animation, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars and National Geographic. That makes it the most useful service for households with children.
Because Disney prices its bundles aggressively, compare the bundle prices before choosing a standalone plan.

services.name: HBO Max
services.extras: A Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max bundle costs $21.99/month with ads or $34.99/month without ads.
services.live_sports: Live sports are included on select plans, according to the HBO Max plan page.
services.kids: A family section with Cartoon Network and Warner animation, but smaller than Disney+.
best_for: HBO series and Warner Bros. films
Viewers who want prestige drama at a mid-range price
not_for: Families who need a large kids catalog
services.answer: HBO Max starts at $10.99 a month with ads and $18.49 ad-free. It is the best pick for HBO originals and Warner Bros. movies; 4K needs Premium at $22.99.
detail: HBO Max sells three plans. Basic with Ads and Standard both stream in Full HD on two devices. Premium adds 4K and four streams.
Annual billing saves money on every plan: $109.99, $184.99 and $229.99 a year.
If you already pay for Disney+ and Hulu, the three-service bundle is usually cheaper than adding HBO Max separately.

services.name: Peacock
services.pricing_source: Peacock Help: How much does a Peacock subscription cost?

plans.name: Select
plans.note: NBC and Bravo shows; no movies, live sports or originals

services.extras: An Apple TV and Peacock Premium Plus bundle is $22.99/month, per Peacock's price-increase notice.
services.live_sports: Premium and Premium Plus carry NBC Sports content, including Sunday Night Football simulcasts and NBA games.
services.kids: DreamWorks and Universal family movies, plus kids profiles.
services.locals: Premium Plus includes your live local NBC station in most markets.
best_for: NBC shows, Bravo and Sunday Night Football
A low-cost sports add-on
not_for: Viewers who want ad-free streaming cheaply
services.answer: Peacock Premium costs $12.99 a month with ads and includes NBC live sports; Premium Plus is $19.99 ad-free. The $8.99 Select plan skips sports, movies and originals.
detail: Peacock raised prices on all three plans in August 2026, its fourth increase in four years.
Select is a stripped-down plan for current and past NBC and Bravo shows. Most people should start at Premium, which adds live sports, movies and Peacock originals.
Premium Plus removes most ads and adds downloads and a live feed of your local NBC station.

services.name: Paramount+

plans.name: Premium
plans.note: Ad-free on most content; includes live local CBS

services.extras: Annual pricing is offered at sign-up.
services.live_sports: CBS Sports events, including NFL on CBS and UEFA Champions League soccer.
services.locals: Premium includes your live local CBS station.
services.trial: Offers vary; check the sign-up page.
best_for: NFL on CBS and Champions League soccer
The cheapest mostly ad-free plan among the big services
not_for: People who want a deep original film library
services.answer: Paramount+ is the cheapest major service with a mostly ad-free plan: Premium is $13.99 a month and includes live local CBS. Essential with ads is $8.99.
detail: Paramount+ has two plans. Essential is $8.99 with ads. Premium is $13.99 and removes ads on most content.
Sports are the main draw: NFL on CBS and UEFA Champions League matches stream here.
Premium raised its price from $12.99 to $13.99 in 2026.

services.name: Prime Video
services.pricing_source: Amazon Help: The Amazon Prime Membership Fee

plans.name: Amazon Prime
plans.note: $139/year; includes Prime Video with ads plus shipping

plans.name: Prime Video Ultra add-on
plans.note: Removes ads; added on top of Prime

services.extras: Prime Video Channels let you add other services (for example Paramount+ or HBO Max) inside the Prime Video app.
services.live_sports: Thursday Night Football and NBA games are streamed on Prime Video.
services.kids: Kids profiles and a family catalog, smaller than Disney+.
services.trial: Amazon usually offers a Prime free trial to new members.
best_for: Households that already pay for Amazon Prime
Thursday Night Football
not_for: People who want ad-free viewing without paying for Prime
services.answer: If you already have Amazon Prime ($14.99 a month or $139 a year), Prime Video is included with ads. Removing ads costs $4.99 a month more. Video-only Prime Video is $8.99.
detail: Prime Video comes with an Amazon Prime membership. Ads are on by default; the Ultra add-on removes them for $4.99 a month, up from $2.99 before 2026.
Live sports include Thursday Night Football and a package of NBA games.
The ad-free price listed in our tables ($19.98) is Prime plus Ultra.

services.name: Apple TV

plans.name: Apple One Individual
plans.note: Starting price; bundles Apple TV with other Apple services

services.extras: Free trial is 7 days, or 3 months with a qualifying new Apple device, per Apple's page.
services.live_sports: Apple announced that all MLS matches are included in the Apple TV subscription starting in 2026, and that it holds US Formula 1 rights from 2026.
services.kids: A small set of family originals.
services.trial: 7 days (3 months with a new Apple device).
best_for: High-quality originals without ads
MLS and Formula 1 fans
not_for: People who want a big back catalog of licensed movies and shows
services.answer: Apple TV (the service formerly called Apple TV+) costs $14.99 a month or $119 a year, with no ads and 4K included. It is a small, originals-only catalog.
detail: Apple raised the price from $12.99 to $14.99 a month on August 28, 2026. The annual plan rose from $99 to $119.
Every subscription is ad-free and includes 4K HDR. The library is almost entirely Apple originals.
Apple One bundles Apple TV with other Apple services and can be cheaper if you pay for iCloud or Apple Music anyway.

services.name: YouTube TV

plans.name: Base plan
plans.note: 100+ channels incl. ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, ESPN

plans.name: Sports + News plan
plans.note: Intro offer shown at $49.99 for 5 months

services.extras: NFL Sunday Ticket is sold as an add-on. Unlimited DVR storage is included.
services.live_sports: Broadcast networks plus ESPN, FS1 and other sports channels; NFL Sunday Ticket add-on.
services.kids: Kids channels included in the base plan.
services.locals: ABC, CBS, FOX and NBC in most markets.
services.trial: The welcome page showed a 21-day trial on November 9, 2026; offers change.
best_for: A full cable replacement with local channels
Unlimited DVR
services.answer: YouTube TV's base plan is $82.99 a month for 100+ live channels, including local ABC, CBS, FOX and NBC in most markets, with unlimited DVR. Cheaper genre plans start at $64.99.
detail: The base plan carries broadcast networks, ESPN and most major cable channels. DVR storage has no limit.
YouTube TV now sells smaller genre plans, such as Sports at $64.99 and Sports + News at $71.99.
It is the only way to get NFL Sunday Ticket as an add-on to a live TV service.

services.name: Sling TV
services.pricing_source: Sling TV home page plan list

plans.name: Blue
plans.note: More channels; some locals in select markets

services.extras: Add-on packs for sports, news and premium channels are sold separately.
services.live_sports: ESPN channels on Orange; NFL Network and regional sports on Blue in some markets.
services.kids: Kids channels vary by plan and add-on.
services.locals: Limited. A few markets get FOX and NBC on Blue; most people pair Sling with an antenna.
best_for: The cheapest way to get ESPN and cable news
People with an antenna for local channels
not_for: Anyone who needs every local channel without an antenna
services.answer: Sling TV is the lowest-cost live TV service with big cable networks: Orange or Blue is $45.99 a month, both together $60.99, and smaller Select and Essentials plans are $19.99.
detail: Sling Orange includes ESPN channels. Sling Blue has a larger lineup and some local channels in select markets.
The $19.99 Select and Essentials plans are pared-down lineups for people who want only a few channels.
Sling carries few local stations, so it works best with an over-the-air antenna.

services.name: Fubo
services.extras: Regional sports networks are included in some markets.
services.live_sports: Sports-first lineup with broadcast networks, ESPN, and regional sports networks in some markets.
services.kids: Kids channels in Pro and Elite.
services.trial: The welcome page showed a 5-day trial on November 9, 2026.
best_for: Sports fans who want regional sports networks
Soccer and international sports
not_for: People who mainly watch entertainment channels
services.answer: Fubo is the sports-focused live TV service. Pro costs $88.99 a month and Elite $98.99, with first-month discounts. A Spanish-language Latino plan is $19.99.
detail: Fubo builds its plans around sports, including regional sports networks in some markets, which many rivals do not carry.
Pro is the main plan. Elite adds more channels.
Disney combined Hulu + Live TV with Fubo in 2025, but the two are still sold as separate services.

services.name: Philo
services.live_sports: No sports networks and no ESPN.
services.kids: Nickelodeon and other family entertainment channels.
best_for: Cable entertainment channels (reality, lifestyle, AMC, Hallmark) at a low price
not_for: Sports, local news or broadcast networks
services.answer: Philo is the cheapest live TV service for entertainment channels: $25 a month for 70+ channels. It has no sports networks and no local channels.
detail: Philo focuses on entertainment and lifestyle cable networks and leaves out sports and news channels to keep its price low.
Bundle+ is $33 a month and adds extra services on top of the Essential lineup.
Pair Philo with an antenna and a sports service if you need those.
